name: eventKit
description: A lazy World of Warcraft event bridge built on MoltenCodes SignalKit.
summary: Lazy game-event subscriptions on SignalKit, unit-event filtering and combat-log routing by sub-event.

Coalescing.description: Coalesce and Derive: events collected into one callback per interval, and values recomputed after a quiet period, timed by TimerKit (a lane by SchedulerKit).
